baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicated lightness of خَفَّتْ attaches to the possessive plural مَوَازِينُهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fewness and reduced load combine with appraisal and just accounting: the plural balances aggregate assessments, but the material available to them is insufficient to establish countervailing weight.

activation_trace.role: Fewness supplies reduced quantity and makes the measured record evidentially insufficient.
Estimation by weight supplies the act of appraising what the record amounts to.
Equitable accounting makes the appraisal adjudicative rather than merely physical.

changed_reading.before: His scales have little physical weight.
changed_reading.after: His multiple reckonings yield too little evidentiary load to carry his case.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same lightness verb and possessive balances can activate insignificance and recognized worth within their own focus-root inventories.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disparagement or treating a right as negligible intersects with weight as standing and value. The balances can therefore be light because the claim they register has lost acknowledged significance, not only because a pan contains little.

activation_trace.role: Disparagement supplies the social act of making a person or right count for little.
Weight as standing or worth turns low weight into failed recognized significance.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a numerical shortfall.
changed_reading.after: The apparatus of his standing has become negligible: his claim carries no acknowledged weight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَفَّتْ can carry agitation while مَوَازِينُ can carry steadiness of judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus roots form a qualitative opposition between levity and weighty deliberation. Light balances may be evaluative criteria that cannot settle, oscillating instead of reaching a firm judgment.

activation_trace.role: Levity and agitation supply instability within the act of evaluation.
Steady, weighty judgment supplies the state that the agitated balances fail to attain.

changed_reading.before: The balances settle a result whose total is low.
changed_reading.after: His criteria of judgment cannot themselves settle into a weighty decision; they tilt and flicker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural balances join reduced load to comparison, alignment, and measured proportion.
baseline_models.mechanism: A balance is not only a container but a relation between terms. Its lightness can mark the failure of correspondences that should align action, value, and measure into a proportioned whole.

activation_trace.role: Reduced load supplies the diminished force borne by the relational structure.
Balancing and alignment make the scales a network of correspondences rather than a single total.
Measured proportion supplies the coherent whole whose internal fit has failed.

changed_reading.after: The relations that should make his account proportionate no longer align into load-bearing weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated striking turns weighing from a static quantity into a dynamic load test. What is light has too little inertia to preserve its alignment when the surrounding event hits.

activation_trace.role: Reduced load makes the focus balances mechanically easy to displace.
Alignment supplies the position that repeated impact threatens to break.
The first collision supplies an external impulse against which the balances are tested.
A second collision makes the impact sustained rather than incidental.
The third collision saturates the approach to the focus with a repeated load.

structural_cues: The same ق ر ع occurrence is supplied at 101:1, 101:2, and 101:3 before the focus contrast.
The focus predicates a change of state of possessive plural balances.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated collision plus focus lightness and alignment; I infer that impact tests whether the weighing structure can hold position. A live alternative is that the striking only names the surrounding event and leaves weight purely quantitative.

changed_reading.after: Under repeated impact, his balances have too little load to keep their evaluative alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired knowledge prompts make the balances an information-bearing interface. Their lightness becomes low evidentiary resolution, while the split root's abundant issue-from-source image permits an exploratory second phase in which consequence forces disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Fewness supplies too little material for a high-resolution inference.
Appraisal makes the balances a procedure for extracting knowledge from evidence.
The knowledge branch frames the first prompt as an epistemic demand on the coming measurement.
The repeated knowledge branch reopens the epistemic demand after the focus result.
The split target's abundant issuing from a source supplies the strange but live image of disclosure breaking out.

structural_cues: Identical د ر ي occurrences appear at 101:3 and 101:10, on opposite sides of the focus sequence.
The packet preserves both targets of the split root mapping.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appraisal, two knowledge prompts, and a split branch of abundant outflow; I infer an evidence-to-knowledge channel and a later forced disclosure. The alternative is that the prompts only heighten rhetoric and the outflow target contributes nothing to this form.

changed_reading.before: The low result is already a transparent verdict.
changed_reading.after: His balances supply too little evidence to make the outcome knowable from the account alone; knowledge arrives as forced disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded severe event and repeated temporal occurrence recast lightness as something that happens to the balances under an appointed transformation, not an essential property of the person.

activation_trace.role: Reduced load supplies the focus state that comes to obtain.
Measured proportion supplies the prior order transformed by the event.
The severe occurrence of a day supplies a bounded event in which ordinary proportions change.
Occurrence in time makes the first transformation an actualized state.
Repeated temporal occurrence extends actualized transformation across a second domain.

structural_cues: The temporal cue at 101:4 is followed by occurrence verbs at 101:4 and 101:5.
The focus uses a completed change-of-state verb for the balances rather than an adjective for the person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe day, repeated becoming, and focus predication on the balances; I infer event-produced reconfiguration rather than essential worthlessness. The alternative is that the temporal language only locates an already fixed verdict.

changed_reading.after: At the event's actualization, his formerly proportionable measures enter a light state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human collectivity becomes light, fluttering, and dispersed, yet the singular relative and attached possessive in the focus rebind plural balances to one person. Measurement restores individual address inside mass disaggregation.

activation_trace.role: Quick light movement connects focus lightness to the surrounding kinetic dispersion.
Just accounting supplies the procedure that preserves individual address.
Human appearance supplies the collective whose ordinary social form is exposed.
The light flying creature supplies unstable, non-aggregated motion.
Scattering dissolves the crowd's cohesion and makes individuation a problem.

structural_cues: The three context roots occur consecutively in 101:4.
The focus shifts from the collective context to مَنْ and the singular possessive suffix on plural balances.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human collective, fluttering lightness, scattering, and singular possession; I infer that accounting re-individuates persons after social cohesion dissolves. The alternative is that the earlier image describes movement only and has no individuation function.

changed_reading.before: A generic member of the crowd receives a low score.
changed_reading.after: Even after the human mass loses cohesion, each person's multiple measures remain irreducibly indexed to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: A solid elevated aggregate becomes soft, broken without separation, and fluffed. Lightness can therefore arise through decompaction and loss of binding while constituent material remains; apparent bulk need not become effective weight.

activation_trace.role: Reduced load supplies the effective result of material decompaction.
Measured proportion supplies the coherent organization that decompaction destroys.
The high solid aggregate supplies maximal initial mass and cohesion.
Tight weaving supplies the binding structure whose undoing can reduce effective weight.
Soft breakage without complete separation allows components to remain while structural resistance vanishes.
Fluffing supplies expansion, low density, and loss of compact load-bearing form.

structural_cues: The 101:5 sequence moves from mountain to soft fiber to a fluffed condition.
The focus follows with lightness predicated of plural measuring structures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solidity, binding, soft breakage, fluffing, proportion, and reduced load; I infer that organizational cohesion converts material into effective weight. The alternative is a simpler subtraction model in which the record is merely sparse.

changed_reading.before: His record is light because it contains little.
changed_reading.after: His record may look voluminous, yet its elements no longer cohere into proportioned, load-bearing weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately supplied heavy balances keep the measuring term constant and reverse its predicate. Because heaviness also carries precious worth, focus lightness is calibrated as the low-value pole of one shared evaluative system.

activation_trace.role: Disparagement supplies the focus-side collapse of acknowledged significance.
Standing and worth make the repeated balances a shared value scale.
The explicit opposite of lightness supplies direct polarity rather than an uncalibrated low amount.
Precious weight supplies qualitative value on the heavy side of the contrast.
Repeated standing or worth holds the evaluative instrument constant across both outcomes.

structural_cues: The supplied balance word occurs at word index 4 in both 101:6 and 101:8.
The predicates at word index 3 are the branch-backed opposites ث ق ل and خ ف ف.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a symmetric lexical contrast and a precious-value branch; I infer one calibrated system in which low weight is low recognized worth. The alternative is that the opposition remains strictly mechanical and adds no status dimension.

changed_reading.after: His standing occupies the devalued pole of the same scale on which the contrasting record is heavy and precious.

context_deltas.mechanism: Livelihood, mutual satisfaction, and guarantee activate the balance as reciprocal credit. Read through the preceding positive outcome, light balances cannot underwrite accepted relations or a stable mode of life.

activation_trace.role: Treating a right as insignificant supplies a deficit in reciprocal recognition.
Balancing two things supplies reciprocity between claims and counterclaims.
Standing or credit supplies the weight needed to sustain the relation.
Livelihood supplies the durable mode of life that adequate relational credit can support.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocal acceptance as an outcome of balanced relations.
The non-dominant target's obedience, love, and guarantee supplies the relation's underwriting bond.

structural_cues: The livelihood and satisfaction cues in 101:7 follow the heavy balances and directly precede the adversative focus at 101:8.
The split ر ض و mapping preserves both mutual acceptance and guarantee-like relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies livelihood, mutual acceptance, guarantee, balance, and the adjacency of the two contrasted cases; I infer that the positive outcome defines the negative case's missing relational credit. The alternative is that 101:7 names a consequence only and does not modify the semantics of focus lightness.

changed_reading.before: His private score is too low.
changed_reading.after: His relational account lacks enough acknowledged weight to sustain reciprocal acceptance and a viable mode of life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Quick departure in focus lightness combines with failed alignment; the next supplied roots add a downward vector, rapid motion, and a gathering endpoint. The measurement releases a trajectory rather than merely displaying a score.

activation_trace.role: Quick movement and departure turn focus lightness into released motion.
Balanced alignment supplies the equilibrium from which the subject is released.
An origin, gatherer, and return-point supplies the trajectory's terminal attractor.
Falling into a depth supplies the trajectory's downward direction.
Rapid onward motion supplies acceleration after equilibrium fails.

structural_cues: The two cited context roots occupy word indices 1 and 2 of 101:9 immediately after the focus.
The focus's static-looking measure is followed by branch-backed destination and motion images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quick departure, failed alignment, a gatherer, falling, and rapid travel; I infer that low weight releases the person from equilibrium into a directed motion. The alternative is that 101:9 only states a destination after an already completed verdict.

changed_reading.before: The light balances are a static display of deficit.
changed_reading.after: Their failed equilibrium releases him into an accelerating downward trajectory toward a gathering endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing fire both illuminates or marks and burns, while the heat-root inventory also carries protection. Focus lightness can therefore be an underweighted protective structure: too little resistance leaves the person exposed to a consequence that becomes visible on the body.

activation_trace.role: Reduced load supplies inadequate resistance in the focus structure.
Measured proportion supplies a protective order whose insufficiency leaves exposure.
Illumination makes the formerly abstract result exposed and perceptible.
Kindled fire and branding supply a medium that consumes and visibly marks.
Heat supplies the force against which the light structure offers too little resistance.
Protection and repulsion supply the counterfunction that is absent or reversed in the heated outcome.

structural_cues: The final supplied ayah places the fire and heat roots in adjacent word positions.
The heat root's inventory preserves both thermal force and protective repulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reduced load, proportion, illumination, fire, heat, and protection; I infer that sufficient evaluative weight could act as resistance and that lightness leaves exposure. The alternative is that protection is inactive here and the final adjective only intensifies temperature.

changed_reading.after: His proportioned defenses carry too little resistance, leaving him exposed to a heat that reveals and marks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the allotment branch of the repeated event-root and the obedience branch of focus lightness rather than ordinary mass. It remains anchored in خَفَّتْ and judicial مَوَازِينُ, but downstream prose should call it a branch-distant agency/allotment possibility, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus lightness can describe yielding response, while its balances can stage equitable adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Light obedience supplies an apparatus that yields readily instead of exerting its own weight.
Judicial balance supplies the arena in which yielding affects an allotted outcome.
Drawing lots supplies external allotment or selection rather than impact.

changed_reading.before: The balances passively register a deficit.
changed_reading.after: His light balances yield too readily before an externally allotted adjudication instead of carrying decisive agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-sensory reading is surprising because color and visible expansion are not themselves weight. It remains anchored in focus fewness and measured proportion through the supplied dyed-fiber and fluffing sequence; render it as a material analogy about salience versus density, not a claim that the balances are literally wool.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus lightness and measured proportion allow apparent bulk to be distinguished from effective weight.

activation_trace.role: Reduced amount supplies low effective density despite visible extent.
Measured proportion distinguishes genuine structure from merely impressive appearance.
Dyed soft fiber supplies vivid sensory salience without corresponding solidity.
Fluffing supplies expanded volume whose density and effective weight are low.

changed_reading.before: A substantial-looking record should be heavy.
changed_reading.after: A vivid, expanded record can look substantial while remaining low-density and nearly weightless.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the next ayah's maternal and gathering branches as a reversal of refuge and belonging. It remains anchored in the focus loss of standing and released motion, but downstream prose should preserve it as an ominous relational topology, not replace the direct outcome reading with literal maternity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Lightness as lost standing and quick departure can mark reassignment from one stable belonging to another destination.

activation_trace.role: Quick departure supplies the severance and motion away from prior belonging.
Lost standing supplies the relational disqualification that precedes reassignment.
Motherhood and nurture supply the expected shape of enclosing refuge.
Origin, gatherer, and return-point turn that refuge into a terminal belonging.
Void and empty air invert the expected content of the enclosing home.

changed_reading.before: Light balances lead to an impersonal penalty.
changed_reading.after: The light account transfers him into a reversed home: a gathering maternal enclosure whose interior is void.

strongest_changes: Lightness became failure under repeated impact, not merely low static mass.
The scattered human collective sharpened the singular possessive balances as a technology of re-individuation.
Mountain-to-fluffed-fiber transformation made decompaction and loss of cohesion a strong alternative to simple scarcity.
The heavy counterpart calibrated lightness as devalued standing within one shared system.
The following fall converted a static measurement into a released downward trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already supported quantity, standing, stability, and proportion; context then changed the operative mechanism several times without forcing a single resolution. Especially live were the material distinction between bulk and effective weight, the persistence of personal indexing amid dispersion, the split epistemic/outflow activation of د ر ي, and the reversal of refuge into a gathering void.
remaining_uncertainties: The plural balances may denote multiple instruments, criteria, records, or repeated acts of appraisal; the packet does not force one.
The material transformations may explain the mechanics of focus lightness or may remain analogies surrounding an otherwise quantitative verdict.
The outflow target of split د ر ي is visibly branch-backed but form-distant, so its disclosure mechanism remains exploratory.
The protection branch of ح م ي may activate a failed shield, or the local heat adjective may exclude that branch from the final mechanism.
The relational-credit reading depends on applying the positive outcome at 101:7 as negative-space contrast to 101:8 rather than treating it as consequence alone.
